summary: A Spanish-language workspace for FM-1 firmware: emulator notes, a rescue guide and a survey of community firmwares, plus ATEK303, an acid bass firmware built on fm1-base.
features: ATEK303: a 303-style voice from Open303 with a diode filter
14 oscillator types, from saw and square to sub and cross-mod blends
64-step acid pattern generator with mutation, lock and undo
Step editor for note, octave, accent, slide and gate
Drive, chorus or flanger, ping-pong delay and plate reverb; 32 presets
MIDI clock in and out, sequencer notes out; docs in Spanish
